skill.summary: Quit cigarettes with smoke-free tracking, craving support, and health recovery timeline

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – helps users quit smoking with tracking, support, and motivation.

- Start and track your quit journey with persistent memory of smoke-free days.
- Get real-time craving support, including substitutions, breathing exercises, and motivational help.
- View a detailed health recovery timeline showing benefits as you stay quit.
- Celebrate quit milestones and track your progress streak.
- Monitor money saved based on cigarettes not purchased.
- All data remains private and stored locally on your device.
